title: Nice single organizers for a drawer; not for hanging; TOO PRICEY
text:
Nice single organizers for a drawer; not for hanging; TOO PRICEY. This is a set of four organizers for different types of Ziplock bags (quart, gallon, sandwich, and snack) that cannot be hung. Each compartment's top comes off as it is lightly held on by magnets. These are for a drawer and are not for hanging. This does away with all those squished and ugly boxes in my cabinets.

In summary, this is a lightweight acrylic unit that is a bit delicate. The current price of $37.99 ($39.99 minus 5%) is overpriced for this in my opinion. It would have received 4 stars if it sold for $29.99 or less.

There are many other Ziplock bag organizer options available on the market such as this [[ASIN:B09KMNHM2J one]] or this [[ASIN:B09VGP1WRL one]]. For one full unit only, then I recommend this [[ASIN:B09RF759BM rustic organizer]]. For a more modern look, I recommend this [[ASIN:B09WN5PZ6Q one]] or an individual heavy plastic set like [[ASIN:B09THNTBGX this]]. For a cheaper unit that has room for foil and plastic wrap, then I highly recommend this [[ASIN:B0B1TPD21S one]] but no screws are provided with that one. product_metadata.title: RUIDEO 4-Pack Storage Bag Organizer Compatible with Ziploc Bags, Acrylic Organizers for Kitchen Organization and Storage, Compatible with Gallon, Quart, Sandwich and Snack Size Bag, Plastic Bag Holder
features: INDEPENDENT ORGANIZERS AND STORAGE FOR KITCHEN - 4 independent boxes can help you maximize your kitchen storage and home organization. Ideal drawer storage organizer for drawer height > 2.7''

EASY TO USE - Compatible with most brands for food storage bags; e.g. Ziploc, Glad, Great Value, Hefty, Up & Up, Solimo, etc. Our Gallon, Quart, Sandwich, and Snack boxes all have 4 non-slip pads attached.

SUSTAINABLE AND DURABLE - Our high-quality clear acrylic material retains color over time and is more durable than bamboo as acrylic organizers and storage are waterproof and weather-resistant for years.
ALL PURPOSE STORAGE ORGANIZER - Each box is fully assembled with a fine magnetic cover. It can also be used as a tea bag organizer. Unlock your mind and get the best use of your kitchen organizer.
FOOD STORAGE BAG HOLDER TIPS - For slider quart size ziplock bags, please make sure bag width is less than 8.5''. For the best user experience, please do not fill the baggie holder too full.
